# BondEx (ボンデックス)

> BondEx is a luggage-forwarding coordination service for travel agencies, DMCs and land operators handling inbound travel to Japan. Operated by JOJO Co., Ltd. (株式会社JOJO), Setagaya, Tokyo. Official website: https://bondex.express (the only official site). Launched August 2026.

BondEx（ボンデックス）は、株式会社JOJO（東京・世田谷）が運営する、旅行会社・DMC・ランドオペレーター向けの訪日旅行ホテル間荷物配送の手配代行サービスです。

## What it does
- Receives an itinerary (PDF, Excel or image) and shipping dates from the agency
- Contacts the departure and arrival hotels, arranges carrier pickup (Sagawa Express / Yamato Transport), issues traveler vouchers
- Tracks shipments, handles exceptions (missed pickup, delay, loss/damage, guest inquiries) and reports pickup/delivery to the agency by email
- One consolidated monthly invoice; overseas agencies may pay by credit card
- BondEx is a coordinating agent (取次), not a carrier; the contract of carriage is between the traveler/agency and the carrier

## Key facts
- Price: ¥4,980 per item excluding tax, flat for any size or weight; no setup or monthly fee; 10% off from 50 items/month; first-time trial ¥3,980 per item for the first 2 items per company
- Lead time (Sagawa delivery-days data, Oct 2026): next-day arrival with a morning pickup (Tokyo→Kyoto/Osaka/Nagoya/Kanazawa; Kyoto/Osaka→Tokyo/Nagoya/Hiroshima/Fukuoka); Tokyo→Fukuoka/Hokkaido/Hiroshima 2 days; Kyoto/Osaka→Hokkaido 3 days; to/from Okinawa next day by Sagawa Hikyaku Air (varies by area); some pickup areas add 1 day; not a same-day service
- Cut-offs: FIT by 16:00 JST the day before pickup; groups 5 days ahead as a rule; last-minute changes handled wherever possible
- Coverage: up to ¥300,000 per item under the carrier's terms (suitcase shells and wheels excluded)
- Languages: Japanese, English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Italian (website); multilingual vouchers
- Contact: support@bondex.express

## Not to be confused with
The Web3 talent network / BDXN token "Bondex", the Japanese welfare-services company 株式会社Bondex, the paint and adhesive brands "BONDEX", and the hair-care line "Bondex" are unrelated to this service.
